increments.snagText: Obligation UUIDs in the api-journey seed are opaque literals
increments.title: Name the obligation UUIDs in UNLOCKED_FULFILMENTS
increments.diagnosis: The api-journey seed carried raw obligation UUID literals, so a reader could not tell which obligation any fixture value belonged to without cross-referencing the frontend obligation model by hand.
increments.refutation: Not triaged through snag-triage — this snag was found and fixed by hand before the workflow existed. Recorded here so the loader does not re-raise it.

filesToTouch.what: Replace opaque UUID literals in UNLOCKED_FULFILMENTS with named constants mirroring the frontend obligation model under src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/

acceptanceCriteria: The api-journey seed names each obligation constant rather than inlining its UUID
Same values on the wire and same fixture behaviour — a pure readability change
verification: typecheck, lint and prettier clean in the tests repo
increments.notes: Landed by Paul Hodgson on 2026-08-07 as 97ee841, on branch chore/EUDPA-315-name-obligation-ids in the tests repo. Unmerged to main at time of seeding. Described in its own commit body as 'part of the post-obligations-merge snagging tracked by EUDPA-315', which is why it belongs in this backlog.
